description: This walk takes you along a section of the Dart Valley Trail from Totnes to the Sharpham Estate. You can follow the waymarked footpath south from the town to reach the estate. The pleasant riverside path runs for a distance of about 2.5 miles on a fairly flat and easy surface. Along the way there are lovely views across the river to the surrounding countryside. At the Sharpham Estate you will find a Grade I listed Palladian villa with parkland, gardens and woodland to explore. There is also a traffic free cycle trail running adjacent to the walking path.
